name: Verified-accessible document engine
justification: Severity: strong primary stats (37% of agencies' top docs conformant; 95.9% of homepages fail) + litigation + hard deadlines. Feasibility: VLM+PDF tagging+validator is buildable solo but hard. Defensibility: verified-correction corpus and eval harness; Adobe risk. Why-now: Title II 2027/2028, EAA, VLM document understanding. Scale: accessibility market has public companies (AudioEye) and $100M+ vendors; system-of-record potential. Distribution: founder's own college + CCC system + listservs. Risk: low legal exposure.

name: Pharmacy below-cost claim detection
justification: Severity: NCPA 96.5% say viability threatened; closures. Feasibility: structured joins + OCR. Defensibility: cross-pharmacy dataset. Why-now: state floors, cost-plus contracts. Scale: ~19k stores x modest ARPU; policy-data upside. Distribution: NCPA/owner groups. Fit: unfamiliar domain, PHI. Risk: HIPAA BAA for a minor founder.

name: PDF-form engine + hosted API
justification: Severity: real but developer-grade pain. Feasibility: pure TS, offline testable. Defensibility: conformance corpus. Why-now: agents filling forms, pdf-lib abandoned. Scale: Apryse-class but slow. Distribution: npm/GitHub. Fit: ideal. Risk: minimal.

name: IEEPA refund recovery + customs compliance
justification: Severity: $1.1B stuck, de minimis end. Feasibility: rules engine. Defensibility: weak, public rules. Why-now: extreme but time-boxed. Scale: compliance OS later. Risk: customs-business licensing (19 CFR 111) may bar filing on behalf of others; must verify.

name: Public-records triage for city clerks
justification: Severity: five firsthand staff statements, 10x volume growth. Feasibility: retrieval+redaction. Defensibility: exemption corpus. Why-now: AI-generated request flood; YC interest. Scale: city hall software is large. Distribution: government sales slow. Risk: redaction liability.

name: Patient-authorized records retrieval for law firms
justification: Severity: 55 OCR settlements, 2500+ info-blocking complaints, law firms pay vendors. Feasibility: depends on FHIR connector coverage and EHR app terms. Defensibility: connector reliability data. Why-now: enforcement escalation 2026. Scale: records-retrieval is a multi-billion market (Datavant). Risk: HIPAA/BA, EHR ToS.

name: Medicaid coverage-retention for safety-net providers
justification: Severity: 80-96% procedural disenrollment; Jan 2027 deadlines. Feasibility: rules+messaging, no state integration needed. Defensibility: outcome data. Why-now: H.R.1. Scale: MCO revenue tied to retention. Distribution: FQHC/MCO sales slow. Fit: unfamiliar. Risk: PHI, vulnerable population.

justification: Severity: real failures but few paying victims yet. Feasibility: Playwright instrumentation. Defensibility: weak unless standard. Why-now: agents mainstream. Scale: infra if standard. Risk: low.

name: Verified-accessibility layer (semantic verifier + outcome-guaranteed remediation)
justification: Competition: Ally free LMS tagging (Jul 2026), OpenDataLoader OSS engine, CivicPlus DocAccess for agenda packets, AI bureaus at $0.06-0.50/page; preexisting-document exception shrinks the archive backlog; DOJ extended deadlines one year. Experiment: VLM extraction is at parity with free OSS (0.906 vs 0.892, n=31) so the engine is NOT a moat; semantic verifier caught 27/27 blanket, 13/15 subtle and ~11/15 real defects that rule checks missed, 0 false flags on 24 correct structures. Insight upgraded (verification gap is real and measurable); severity, why-now and distribution downgraded.

name: Intake-flood defense for public-records offices (bot/commercial requester triage)
justification: Competition: NextRequest/GovQA/JustFOIA already market AI redaction and email search; contracts $9.5K-$40K/yr; bundling lock-in; exits are acqui-features. Why-now upgraded: CA SB 1159/AB 1821 effective 2027-01-01 explicitly allow detection tools; TechCrunch Sept 2026 on agents flooding public services. Bolt-on only.

name: Neutral reimbursement-floor evidence engine for independent pharmacies
justification: Competition: PSAO tools (Health Mart Atlas, Cardinal, EPIC RxRegulator), Inmar/Net-Rx, RxDelta ($199-799/mo), nadaclookup ($29/mo). Kill evidence: MAC appeals paid ~10% (NY) and >98% denied (MS audit); ESI cost-plus routes invoices to PBM.

name: XFA-capable verified form-filling engine
justification: Competition: @cantoo/pdf-lib and Documenso LibPDF maintain the library; hosted fill at 0.1-10 cents; only XFA hybrid gap remains.

name: Customs compliance for small importers
justification: Competition: Flexport free refund calculator; ~76% of refund dollars processed; 19 CFR 111 customs-business limits; crowded $39-500/mo classification tools.

name: Patient-directed records retrieval
justification: Competition: ChartSquad, Arctrieval, Codes Health (in Filevine), Fasten Connect, Flexpa. Admissibility needs custodian certification; Human API/Ciitizen precedent.

name: Medicaid coverage retention
justification: Competition: CMS/state verification tools (Emmy, OSCER), mPulse, Cotiviti Eliza, CareMessage (nonprofit), Fortuna Health ($22M). GSA RCT: nudges did not change renewals.
